freeze_note: Draft tolerances anchored on the paper profile (DPMP, deepmd-jax) and the published dataset statistics. V4 values are deliberately loose (0.05 eV/atom E, 0.25 eV/A F) so a scientifically sound agent run is not mis-killed before calibration. FREEZE REQUIRES n_runs>=2 independent expert reruns of the full GO-water DPMP pipeline (see VALIDATION.json G10); then thresholds are tightened to the observed expert spread.

V4.alignment: mean-offset aligned energy RMSE, eV/atom; raw force RMSE, eV/A
V4.units_note: energies in eV total (published units); per-atom after division by natoms

V6.density_units: oxygen number density (nm^-3) vs minimum-image distance from graphite plane
V6.peak_detection_note: first hydration-layer peak = global max of smoothed O density in d in [2.0, Lz/2) A; depletion = 25% rise edge. Pristine graphene excludes water O to ~2.5 A, so the 1.45 A spike in the raw histogram is sparse-count noise, not a layer.
